prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 6 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1418; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion consistent with whiplash-type cervical strain. Over the course of six visits, the patient received a structured program of manual therapy, targeted stretching, and graded home exercise. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the cervical soft tissue injury, and the objective deficits documented at intake are reflected in the follow-up measurements. No prior injury to the cervical region is known from the patient history or records reviewed. Recovery has been progressing, though it has taken somewhat longer than is typical for this presentation, and the pace of improvement has been gradual. At this stage it is not yet clear whether the injury is wholly attributable to this collision, and further assessment is planned to clarify the causal relationship. Billing records reviewed for the episode show no repeated charges for the same services. Ongoing care will focus on restoring full mobility and strength, with reassessment at defined intervals.
